title: Announcing our Investment in Coast
summary: Intuit Ventures announces its investment in Coast, a spend management platform helping trades and field service businesses control spending, streamline bookkeeping, and integrate with QuickBooks.

- Announcing our Investment in Coast


Intuit Ventures is excited to share our investment in[Coast](https://www.coastpay.com/) , the financial platform for the physical economy. We’re participating in their latest financing round alongside Thomvest Ventures, ICONIQ Growth, Accel, Better Tomorrow Ventures, and others.


America’s trades businesses from construction, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, and field services manage a uniquely demanding financial back office. Their employees are dispersed across job sites and often make purchases of fuel, materials, and supplies without a manager present. Owners and finance leaders need to control that spend in advance, verify it after the fact, and tie every transaction back to a vehicle, driver, or job all without slowing down the work. For decades, their options were legacy fleet cards built on dated technology or general-purpose corporate cards that were never designed for how these businesses operate. Intuit knows this segment first-hand: trades and field services businesses represent a meaningful part of the QuickBooks community, and we’ve seen how much time they lose to fragmented spend management and manual reconciliation.


Coast’s product has been designed and built from the ground up for businesses like these. The company started with a fuel card built on the Visa network with real-time spend controls, GPS-linked purchase verification, and integrations with the telematics and field service software these businesses already use. Since then, they have expanded into a full spend management platform; including a corporate card with job-costing workflows, expense management that syncs in real time to financial systems including QuickBooks, and Coast bill pay. Today, thousands of businesses operating well over 100,000 vehicles run their spend on Coast, and the company is growing rapidly as it becomes embedded in the software fleets rely on every day.


Coast’s spend data flows seamlessly into solutions like Intuit QuickBooks and help trades businesses close their books faster as well as see project-level profitability clearly. We invested in Coast because it advances Intuit’s vision of bringing financial intelligence to every consumer, business, and accountant. We’re excited to explore how Coast and QuickBooks can better serve our joint customers together, bringing trades businesses one platform to grow and run their operations.


Congratulations to[Daniel Simon](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielmsimon/) and the entire Coast team on this milestone!


Read more about Coast and their latest raise[here](https://coastpay.com/blog/coast-raises-35m-to-build-the-financial-platform-for-the-physical-economy/) .
